LanguageData.Gun_Raging_Judge_RWP.label: Raging Judge
LanguageData.Gun_Raging_Judge_RWP.description: Raging Judge is a formidable revolver designed for maximum stopping power. It fires large-caliber rounds with a devastating impact, making it ideal for close-quarters combat. Despite its intimidating force, it maintains a reasonable firing rate and reliability. However, its heavy recoil requires steady handling and careful aim. Perfect for colonists who need sheer brute strength in firefights.
